items.title: 西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害原因现已查明
items.summary: 8月30日，西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在西藏自治区日喀则市吉隆县吉隆镇举行。截至29日18时，灾害造成16人遇难，546人失联。图为西藏自治区吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部指挥长，自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登介绍相关情况。中新社记者 李林 摄 8月30日，西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在西藏自治区日喀则市吉隆县吉隆镇举行。经外事、公安、文旅、应急等多部门联合开展全域拉网排查、线索溯源比对，目前西藏吉隆泥石流灾害排查出261名失联外籍人员，涵盖哈萨克斯坦1人、马来西亚3人、尼泊尔104人、印度49人、南非4人、爱尔兰2人、爱沙尼亚2人、德国3人、俄罗斯3人、法国2人、芬兰1人、荷兰2人、拉脱维亚33人、立陶宛1人、葡萄牙1人、乌克兰1人、西班牙1人、匈牙利1人、英国15人、加拿大6人、美国18人、澳大利亚6人、新西兰2人，共23个国家，中方已向有关国家驻华使馆通报。图为西藏自治区吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部副指挥长、自治区副主席赵鹏（右一）介绍相关情况。中新社记者 李林 摄 8月30日，西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在西藏自治区日喀则市吉隆县吉隆镇举行。灾害涉及的5个村共499名民众已全部安全撤离至酒店和民宿5个安置点，全力保障他们的入住和一日三餐。累计调拨青稞、面粉等116吨，方便面、饮用水等3.2万余箱（件），帐篷、折叠床、衣被等应急物资5.7万余件（套），确保住得温暖，按时吃上热乎饭菜。图为西藏自治区吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部副指挥长，日喀则市委副书记，代理市长罗布次仁介绍相关情况。中新社记者 李林 摄 8月30日，西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在西藏自治区日喀则市吉隆县吉隆镇举行。截至29日18时，灾害造成16人遇难，546人失联，搜救尚未再发现幸存者。西藏自治区吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部常务副指挥长，自治党委常委、政府常务副主席任维介绍相关情况。中新社记者 李林 摄

items.title: Lavish spending fails to fix Tottenham’s big issue – the lack of soul and spine | Jonathan Liew
items.summary: It might be too early to push the panic button but Roberto De Zerbi faces a huge task if he is to turn Spurs aroundTime for Tottenham to start panicking? This is, of course, a subtle trick question. Tottenham is one of those clubs that never actually stops panicking. They panic when they concede and they panic when they score. They panic when they have the ball and they panic when someone else does. They have a coach in Roberto De Zerbi whose face evokes a state of permanent alarm, the expression of a man perpetually having a toilet door opened on him. One year they even managed to panic their way to the Europa League. For the ever-rattled Spurs fan, this club is less a treasured devotion and more a lifelong haunting, broken up by occasional panic substitutions.You could intuit that sense of encrusted resignation pretty much from the moment Anthony Elanga’s improvised shot kissed the post and trickled over the line to give Newcastle the lead. Since beating Aston Villa 4-1 in late 2024, Tottenham have gone behind 44 times in all competitions and come back to win precisely zero of them. There is something innate and endemic here, a chronic case of Long Tottenham for which – despite the new coach, the new leadership structure and more than a third of a billion pounds in transfer fees – there remains no proven cure. Yoane Wissa’s clincher was of zero surprise to anyone. Continue reading...

items.summary: Norris: ‘I want my whole career to be with McLaren’F1 title holder says other teams have approached himLando Norris has said he would like to see out his career with McLaren, as the defending Formula One world champion announced he has agreed a multi-year deal until at least 2030 with the team he described as like “a second family”.The 26-year-old, who won his first F1 title last season, joined McLaren to make his debut in the sport in 2019. He has been with them ever since and his current contract was due to run until the end of this year. Norris emphasised that he had not countenanced leaving McLaren and had made no approaches toward other teams – although some had made advances towards him. Continue reading...

items.title: Faster, higher, funnier: what we learned from China’s robot games
items.summary: Five-day showcase reveals leaps Beijing has made in humanoid tech, but also its limitations as US rivals come up from the rearWith exploding pelvises, enough comic pratfalls for a Buster Keaton show reel and the odd moment of ruthless violence, the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing gripped the world this week with an unsettling mixture of hilarity, trepidation and relief.The five-day showcase staked out China’s claim to undisputed leadership in humanoid robotics as android martial artists landed knockout roundhouse kicks and robot teams marched into the arena heralded by flag-waving captains astride giant robotic dogs. The games’ blue-riband event, the 100m, did not disappoint when the robot-sprinters ran quicker than Usain Bolt before slamming mindlessly into a padded wall in a blaze of sparks, flames and flying mechanical limbs.
